question: Which of these immunoglobulins is important in type I hypersensitivity reactions ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: IgE -> binds to mast cells and basophils -> triggers release of histamine and other inflammatory mediators -> important in type I hypersensitivity reactions -> 95%
enhanced_information: IgE is important in type I hypersensitivity reactions as it binds to mast cells and basophils, triggering the release of histamine and other inflammatory mediators. This is supported by the interaction between IgE and basophils.
analysis: IgE is the immunoglobulin important in type I hypersensitivity reactions as it binds to mast cells and basophils, triggering the release of histamine and other inflammatory mediators. This is a well-established fact in immunology.
